summary: Narrow tree-lined lane beside apartments 11-12 m away, no room to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane, hedge and bank at edge

best_section.where: Brasted Street west kerb just up from the bend and give-way

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 11-12 m away on the west side and homes across the lane; well overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane is narrow with dense vegetation and a bank at the edge; a van would block the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side lane, light local use.
drivers.convention: One or two cars stand at the junction only; no overnight parking pattern.

flags: Slope about 6.5%, over the 3% steep mark
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy over the lane.
cannot_judge: Kerb width and verge firmness under trees
